items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1957-08-04
items.q: He said then he started playing with Joe Petit. ... And then he went and played with Joe Petit. That's his first job with cornet out there.

ctx.x: Well, he's his father. He lives on Dernan, New Orleans. And then my brother came to my father and mother and told him that he said he had a man playing. He said then he started playing with Joe Petit. But his first job was in the district on Murray Street at Hannan's Saloon, Murray and Alvabelle. And before he started playing music, he was working in Michalis' juror store when he was a little bit of a kid on Rylan Beaville. Then he started going with Joe Petit. He was a travel player, of course. He was a travel…
Yes, I knew him. He was a travel player.
